popCulture.title: Description of Greece
popCulture.creator: Pausanias
popCulture.description: Pausanias names the dryad Erato as Arcas' wife and mother of Azan, Apheidas, and Elatus — Arcadia's three houses from a tree-nymph, not the Muse Erato.

popCulture.title: Erato (dryad)
popCulture.description: Arcadian dryad consort of Arcas — distinct from the Muse Erato of lyric poetry.
